label: Canakinumab — rheumatoid arthritis · Ait-Oudhia 2012 · 2-compartment SC/IV
_note: PK part of a PK-binding-PD model of canakinumab in RA (472 patients, 4 trials, SC and 2-h IV). Canakinumab is not approved for RA; the model is included as a published SC model.

_source.document: Ait-Oudhia, Lowe, Mager 2012, CPT Pharmacometrics Syst Pharmacol 1:e5 (doi:10.1038/psp.2012.6, PMC3603473)
_source.subjects: 472 RA patients (349 on canakinumab), 80% women, median 57 y, median 74 kg; 0.1 mg/kg to 900 mg, SC or 2-h IV, Q2W or Q4W

limitations: Values within the paper are inconsistent: the half-life computed from the tabulated CL of 0.104 L/day is about 44 days, but the text gives a drug half-life of 25 days, and the CL in the text is 0.107. The Novartis pooled analysis of the same drug (RA, 70 kg) has CL 0.214 L/day.
The paper gives no numerical exposure values (Cmax, Ctrough, AUC) to validate against. Only the single half-life row is compared.
Between-subject variability was reported only as 'apparent CV', so it was converted with ln(1+CV²); the variability in bioavailability (3.68%) was omitted because it is small.
IL-1β binding is not simulated. Rheumatoid arthritis is not an approved indication.

reportedChecks.source: Ait-Oudhia, Lowe, Mager 2012, CPT Pharmacometrics Syst Pharmacol 1:e5 (doi:10.1038/psp.2012.6, PMC3603473) Results — drug vs IL-1beta half-life '(4.5 h vs. 25 days)'. +-20% assumed.
